prompt:
Return exactly one JSON object with the sole top-level key resources, whose value is an array of Kubernetes resource objects. No Markdown fences, comments, explanations, duplicate keys, or additional resources. Use Kubernetes 1.34 API schemas. This is a static configuration task; do not execute commands or contact a cluster.

Create exactly an apps/v1 Deployment api and policy/v1 PodDisruptionBudget api in namespace bench. Deployment: 3 replicas; selector and pod labels app=api; exactly one container app with image nginx:1.28.0. Pod securityContext must explicitly set runAsNonRoot true, runAsUser 10001 and seccompProfile.type RuntimeDefault. Disable automountServiceAccountToken. Container securityContext must set allowPrivilegeEscalation false, readOnlyRootFilesystem true, capabilities.drop ["ALL"], with no other securityContext keys. PDB: minAvailable 2, selector.matchLabels app=api, no maxUnavailable. This checks declared settings only; no image/runtime compatibility is implied. Selectors must include app=api in matchLabels (or the Service selector map) and match the Deployment pod labels. Additional pod labels and selector constraints are allowed when they still match those pods.
